verdict_rule: hyp_cells.verdict: design fold fixes the sign; confirm fold decides. CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE = confirm mean > 0, t >= 2, design mean > 0; FAILED_VARIANT = confirm mean <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE <= effect worth having; else CANNOT_DISTINGUISH. SE over date blocks, MDE = 2.8 SE.

cells.title: Guidance-cut read-through to correlation peers
cells.refutation: If correlation peers' next-session residual is not more negative than vol-matched uncorrelated peers (spread >= 0, t < 1), refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Compare correlation peers to vol-matched uncorrelated names in the same sector; the peer-minus-control residual spread should be negative.

cells.title: Regulatory approval for one firm lifts co-mentioned peers
cells.refutation: If co-mentioned peers show no significant next-session abnormal return relative to vol-matched unlinked peers, the hypothesis is refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Compare peers' next-session return to their own market-beta-adjusted return and to vol-matched non-linked peers; effect should be present only for co-mentioned peers.

cells.title: Equity issuance dilution hits correlated peers
cells.refutation: No significant peer underperformance versus vol-matched unlinked controls in the confirm sample.
cells.separation_from_beta: Peer underperformance exceeds its beta-implied move and is larger than vol-matched unlinked names.
